rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site information for the Cam-CAN normative dataset not reported.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "A large open neuroimaging dataset by the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN) [29], containing MEG and MRI measurements of nearly 700 healthy participants aged 18 to 87, was used for creating the normative reference data."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Cam-CAN used as the normative reference dataset.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "A large open neuroimaging dataset by the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN) [29]... was used for creating the normative reference data."

rci3_epd_name.detail: Cam-CAN dataset used for normative modeling.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "A large open neuroimaging dataset by the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN) [29]... was used for creating the normative reference data."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase normative reference dataset; subjects with missing or incomplete data excluded.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "Subjects with missing or incomplete resting-state MEG measurements or T1-weighted MRI images were excluded from the analyses, resulting in a set of 621 subjects."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; sex breakdown for the final 621-subject normative dataset not reported (only approximate balance by decade described).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "The curated, cross-sectional Cam-CAN dataset contains measurements from approximately 50 men and 50 women in each age decade (18-27, 28-37, 38-47, 48-57, 58-67, 68-77 and 78-87 years)."

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age range reported for Cam-CAN normative dataset; mean/SD not reported.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "A large open neuroimaging dataset by the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN) [29], containing MEG and MRI measurements of nearly 700 healthy participants aged 18 to 87, was used for creating the normative reference data."
